messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sample-chat-app hit a confusing SDK error during fresh signup flow. Need quick parity / message-fix for DX.

aiden: ugh, what did it show? link or logs?

maria: root: got a 401 but the text said 'permission denied'. Py SDK raised ForbiddenError (which made the frontend show 'check team perms'), JS SDK raised UnauthorizedError. That mismatch caused the onboarding UI to show the wrong next step and users got stuck.

sasha: can you paste the raw error payload?

maria: sure — from the hosted API response:```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "permission denied",
  "detail": "token expired or invalid"
}
```

aiden: ok two problems: 1) status/text mismatch (should be clearer), 2) SDK mapping inconsistency across languages.

sasha: agreed. proposal: canonical mapping rules: 401 -> UnauthorizedError, 403 -> ForbiddenError, 429 -> RateLimitError (include retry info), 503/502 -> TransientServiceError (retryable). Also error.message should be human-friendly by default.

jamie: we also need a typed field for machine consumption, e.g. "code": "unauthorized" and "retry_hint": "retry-after-seconds=30" or null. That helps SDKs set `retryable=true/false` and surface consistent UI.

maria: love the structured field idea. Right now sample apps expect a string only which makes UX hacks.

ci-bot: test failure #4582 in sample-chat-app: expected UnauthorizedError but got ForbiddenError in py-sdk smoke. See CI logs: https://ci.internal/4582

aiden: who owns SDK parity matrix? I can take JS/Py coordination. Can we add an automated check that asserts mapping for the five canonical statuses?

sasha: I can add an API contract test on the control plane side that returns canonical JSON (status + code + message + retry_hint). SDKs can import a small fixtures file.

jamie: I'll add tests in py/js/go sdk smoke suites. Quick plan: add a table in repo: `status -> canonical_code -> message_template -> retryable` and fail if SDK maps diverge. PR coming today.

maria: small copy ask for product: preferred UX copy for 401: "Invalid API key or expired token — sign in or check your key." For 403: "Access to this resource is restricted — contact your org admin." For 429: "Rate limit exceeded — retry after Xs (we've automated backoff)."

aiden: can we also ensure SDK exceptions include `.retry_after` and `.is_retryable` booleans so onboarding app can decide to show a spinner vs error page?

sasha: yep. API should return `retry_hint` as seconds. SDKs convert to `.retry_after` int or null and `is_retryable = retry_after != null || status in [502,503]`.

jamie: small gotcha: some downstream infra returns 401 for expired refresh tokens vs missing scopes. We should add `subcode` for internal differentiators so frontends can give targeted advice without leaking policy details. e.g. `401` + `subcode: token_expired` vs `401` + `subcode: missing_key`.

maria: that would be very helpful for onboarding flow messages.

aiden: timeline: I'll open an issue to track parity + add smoke tests. Jamie, please add SDK tests. Sasha will add contract test. Maria will draft copy and sample-app changes. Can we aim for a small rollout next week?

jamie: yep, PR for tests today, sample-app PR tomorrow.

sasha: contract test PR by EOD.

maria: thanks team :+1: Let's also patch the sample app to catch mismatched exception classes and surface the raw status/code while we wait for parity. Saves new users pain.

ci-bot: noted: ticket DF-221 created for sample-app hotfix.

aiden: thanks — I'll ping infra if we need changes to error generator stubs.

maria: ok wrapping up — will post a short RFC with examples and the copy table so engs and product can align. :thinking_face:
